literature.headline_zh: 人腺病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人腺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 观察到染色质可及性的广泛变化,在感染后 48 小时和 72 小时分别鉴定出 7,055 和 10,736 个 DAR。这些变化富含增强子/基因间和内含子区域,并且在蛋白质编码基因和非编码基因之间存在差异。通路富集分析显示 Wnt 信号通路基因的染色质可及性增加。 [10.1128/jvi.01570-26]
公共血液和儿科 PBMC 数据显示干扰素、炎症、TNF-α/NF-κB、IL-6/JAK/STAT3、补体和骨髓相关程序。在同一只小鼠中,HAdV-7 感染后,18 种可测试的 BALF 分析物中有 17 种增加,而 29 种可测试的血清分析物在校正后均不显着。 [10.1186/s12985-026-03339-3]
筛选产生了多种抗腺病毒化合物,其中 MCT1 抑制剂显示出明显的 抗病毒药物 活性。MCT1 抑制与 抗病毒药物 活性相关,MCT1 和 MCT4 联合抑制可协同阻断转化细胞和原代正常人支气管上皮细胞中的 HAdV 感染。 [10.1128/aac.00425-26]
72 个样本中的 55 个样本中至少检测到一种病毒靶点 (76.4%),其中 HAdV 是最常检测到的病毒 (48.6%),其次是 JCPyV (27.8%)、BKPyV (22.2%) 和 HAV (16.7%)。 [10.1007/s11356-026-38364-w]
猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 的计算机分析显示出明显的生化差异,可能影响受体结合和下游信号传导。最高剂量的 Ad5-pIFN ω5 完全保护猪免受攻击,表明无菌免疫。 [10.1186/s13567-026-01879-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Widespread changes in chromatin accessibility were observed, with 7,055 and 10,736 DARs identified at 48 and 72 hours post-infection, respectively. These changes were enriched in enhancer/intergenic and intronic regions, and differed between protein-coding and non-coding genes. [10.1128/jvi.01570-26]

Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs. In the same mice, 17 of 18 testable BALF analytes increased after HAdV-7 infection, whereas none of 29 testable serum analytes remained significant after correction. [10.1186/s12985-026-03339-3]

The screen yielded numerous anti-adenoviral compounds, with MCT1 inhibitors showing clear antiviral activity. MCT1 inhibition correlated with antiviral activity, and combined MCT1 and MCT4 inhibition synergistically blocked HAdV infection in both transformed and primary normal human bronchial epithelial cells. [10.1128/aac.00425-26]

At least one viral target was detected in 55 of 72 samples (76.4%), with HAdV being the most frequently detected virus (48.6%), followed by JCPyV (27.8%), BKPyV (22.2%), and HAV (16.7%). [10.1007/s11356-026-38364-w]

In silico analysis of porcine IFN α1 and porcine IFN ω5 demonstrated distinct biochemical differences that could affect receptor binding and downstream signaling. The highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected swine against challenge, suggesting sterile immunity. [10.1186/s13567-026-01879-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
Widespread changes in chromatin accessibility were observed, with 7,055 and 10,736 DARs identified at 48 and 72 hours post-infection, respectively.
Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs.

papers.title: Changes in the chromatin accessibility landscape during human adenovirus infection.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Viral infections rewire the cellular environment, and this is often achieved through chromatin remodeling. Human adenovirus (HAdV) can directly modify specific cellular chromatin features; however, we still lack a global view of the changes in the cellular chromatin landscape induced during infection. To address how host chromatin accessibility changes during HAdV-C5 infection, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We detected widespread changes in chromatin accessibility, with 7,055 and 10,736 differentially accessible regions (DARs) on host chromatin at 48 and 72 h post-infection, respectively. At both time points, these changes mostly occurred in enhancer/intergenic regions and intronic regions. Furthermore, the pattern of changes in accessibility differed between protein-coding and non-coding genes. Integration of the ATAC-seq data with RNA-seq data demonstrated that significant changes in chromatin accessibility coincided with significant changes in gene expression during infection. Additionally, we found that increased DARs were enriched for forkhead and TEA domain transcription factor family motifs, while decreased DARs were enriched for motifs from zinc finger and basic leucine zipper domain families. Pathway enrichment analysis revealed that Wnt signaling pathway genes displayed increased chromatin accessibility during infection. Inhibition of the Wnt signaling pathway reduced viral gene expression and infectious viral progeny production, suggesting that this pathway is important for productive infection. Together, these data demonstrate that cellular chromatin is extensively remodeled during HAdV infection and expand our understanding of host-cell transcriptional regulation by human adenovirus. IMPORTANCE: Human adenovirus-C5 (HAdV-C5) infection extensively modifies the cellular transcriptome and proteome. However, other important aspects of the cellular environment, such as global changes in chromatin accessibility, have yet to be fully characterized during infection. Here, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in infected growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We observed genome-wide changes in cellular chromatin accessibility and identified specific transcription factor motifs located in differentially accessible regions during infection. This work contributes another key piece to our understanding of how human adenovirus infection reprograms the host-cell environment and will inform future work directed toward specific chromatin modifications manipulated by HAdV that impact host-cell chromatin accessibility.

papers.abstract_zh: 未标记:病毒感染会重新连接细胞环境,这通常是通过染色质重塑来实现的。人腺病毒(HAdV)可以直接修饰特定的细胞染色质特征;然而,我们仍然缺乏对感染过程中引起的细胞染色质景观变化的全面了解。为了解决 宿主 染色质可及性在 HAdV-C5 感染期间如何变化,我们在感染后 48 和 72 小时,使用测序 (ATAC-seq) 在生长停滞的二倍体人肺成纤维细胞 (IMR-90) 细胞中对转座酶可及染色质进行了测定。我们检测到染色质可及性发生广泛变化,感染后 48 小时和 72 小时,宿主 染色质上分别有 7,055 个和 10,736 个差异可及区域 (DAR)。在这两个时间点,这些变化主要发生在增强子/基因间区域和内含子区域。此外,蛋白质编码基因和非编码基因的可及性变化模式不同。ATAC-seq 数据与 RNA-seq 数据的整合表明,染色质可及性的显着变化与感染期间基因表达的显着变化相一致。此外,我们发现增加的 DAR 富集叉头和 TEA 结构域转录因子家族基序,而减少的 DAR 富集锌指和碱性亮氨酸拉链结构域家族的基序。通路富集分析显示,Wnt 信号通路基因在感染过程中表现出染色质可及性增加。抑制 Wnt 信号通路可减少病毒基因表达和感染性病毒后代的产生,表明该通路对于生产性感染很重要。总之,这些数据表明细胞染色质在 HAdV 感染期间被广泛重塑,并扩展了我们对 宿主 细胞转录调控的理解。重要性:人腺病毒-C5 (HAdV-C5) 感染会广泛修改细胞转录组和蛋白质组。然而,细胞环境的其他重要方面,例如染色质可及性的整体变化,在感染过程中尚未得到充分表征。在这里,我们在感染后 48 小时和 72 小时使用测序 (ATAC-seq) 对受感染的生长停滞的二倍体人肺成纤维细胞 (IMR-90) 细胞进行转座酶可及染色质分析。我们观察到 基因组 细胞染色质可及性的广泛变化,并确定了感染期间位于不同可及区域的特定转录因子基序。这项工作为我们理解 人腺病毒 感染如何重新编程 宿主 细胞环境提供了另一个关键部分,并将为未来针对 HAdV 操纵的影响 宿主 细胞染色质可及性的特定染色质修饰的工作提供信息。

analysis_zh.methods: ATAC-seq 用于识别 HAdV-C5 感染期间 宿主 染色质中的差异可及性区域 (DAR),将 ATAC-seq 数据与 RNA-seq 数据整合,将染色质可及性的变化与基因表达相关联。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现扩展了我们对 HAdV 对 宿主 细胞转录调控的理解,并将为未来研究 HAdV 操纵的影响 宿主 细胞染色质可及性的特定染色质修饰的工作提供信息。

papers.title: Inhibitors of monocarboxylate transporters as host-directed antivirals against human adenoviruses.
papers.abstract: Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are non-enveloped double-stranded DNA viruses that cause a wide range of typically mild, self-limiting infections in humans, but are associated with high morbidity and mortality in immunocompromised individuals. There are currently no approved antivirals specifically targeting HAdV infection. To identify novel anti-adenoviral compounds and host factors critical for infection, we screened a target-annotated library of 13,000 compounds, covering 1,763 known human targets, against HAdV type 11 in K562 cells. This screen yielded numerous anti-adenoviral compounds, many of which were kinase inhibitors, well known to also show antiviral activity. We instead focused on potent and selective inhibitors of monocarboxylate transporter 1 (MCT1) for further investigation. For 25 MCT1 inhibitors, antiviral activity correlated clearly with MCT1 inhibitory potency, indicating MCT1 inhibition as the likely mechanism. MCT1 exports lactate and is frequently overexpressed in cancers that rely on aerobic glycolysis; many viruses similarly reprogram host metabolism toward glycolysis, increasing intracellular lactate that must be effluxed. Unexpectedly, MCT1 inhibitors were ineffective in A549 cells due to compensatory activity of MCT4, as A549 cells express both MCT1 and MCT4, whereas K562 cells express only MCT1. A selective MCT4 inhibitor was inactive in both cell lines, suggesting that simultaneous inhibition of both transporters is required. Accordingly, combined MCT1 and MCT4 inhibition synergistically blocked HAdV infection in both transformed cell types and primary normal human bronchial epithelial cells. These findings underscore the importance of host cell metabolism in HAdV infection and identify MCTs as promising antiviral targets.

papers.abstract_zh: 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是无包膜双链 DNA 病毒,可在人类中引起多种典型的轻度自限性感染,但与免疫功能低下个体的高发病率和 死亡率 相关。目前尚无批准的专门针对 HAdV 感染的 抗病毒药物。为了鉴定新型抗腺病毒化合物和对感染至关重要的 宿主 因子,我们针对 K562 细胞中的 11 型 HAdV 筛选了包含 13,000 种化合物的靶标注释库,涵盖 1,763 个已知人类靶标。该筛选产生了许多抗腺病毒化合物,其中许多是激酶抑制剂,众所周知也显示出 抗病毒药物 活性。相反,我们将重点放在单羧酸转运蛋白 1 (MCT1) 的有效和选择性抑制剂上以进行进一步研究。对于 25 种 MCT1 抑制剂,抗病毒药物 活性与 MCT1 抑制效力明显相关,表明 MCT1 抑制是可能的机制。MCT1 输出乳酸,并且在依赖有氧糖酵解的癌症中经常过度表达;许多病毒类似地将 宿主 代谢重新编程为糖酵解,增加必须流出的细胞内乳酸。出乎意料的是,由于MCT4的代偿活性,MCT1抑制剂对A549细胞无效,因为A549细胞同时表达MCT1和MCT4,而K562细胞仅表达MCT1。选择性 MCT4 抑制剂在两种细胞系中均无活性,表明需要同时抑制两种转运蛋白。因此,联合抑制 MCT1 和 MCT4 可协同阻断转化细胞类型和原代正常人支气管上皮细胞中的 HAdV 感染。这些发现强调了 宿主 细胞代谢在 HAdV 感染中的重要性,并将 MCT 确定为有希望的 抗病毒药物 靶点。

papers.title: A Confirmatory, Dual Center Nonhuman Primate Study on the Efficacy of Novel Oropharyngeal Spray Immunization With an Adenoviral Vector Vaccine Against RSV-Important Lessons Learned.
papers.abstract: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in a dual-center, randomized, blinded trial involving rhesus macaques. The DNA vaccine was administered via electroporation, followed by mucosal adenoviral boosters encoding the RSV fusion protein (F). Control groups included mock-vaccinated animals and those mimicking natural immunity from primary RSV infection. The study observed robust immune responses but noted variability between centers. RSV-vaccinated animals showed reduced viral replication in the respiratory tract after challenge. However, unexpected immunity in the control group at one site hindered confirmation of the primary endpoint. The results suggest that mucosal adenoviral boosting may be effective for RSV vaccine development, but multi-center trials face challenges. These findings have implications for improving vaccine strategies and addressing limitations in preclinical research.

papers.title: Parallel transcriptomic and single-cell analyses characterize innate immune responses in human adenovirus infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Human adenovirus (HAdV) can cause severe pediatric pneumonia, but peripheral blood does not directly represent the immune response in the lung. We examined independent blood and lung datasets to define shared directions and local cellular patterns. Methods Two public blood transcriptome datasets were analyzed alongside RNA-seq data from 13 children with HAdV infection and 10 non-infectious controls. Mouse lung scRNA-seq compared control, HAdV-3, and HAdV-7 groups, with three mice per group. Cell proportions and module scores used mice as biological replicates. CellChat was performed on group-pooled cells. Serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), lung IL-1β, and infected THP-1 cells provided independent validation. Results Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs. Mild ( n = 3) and severe ( n = 10) PBMC cases overlapped in PCA, and six immune signatures had adjusted P values of 1.00. The lung atlas contained 17 populations and localized antiviral and inflammatory programs mainly to myeloid cells. Several populations were unevenly distributed among mice. No mouse-level proportion or module-score comparison remained significant after correction; with n = 3 versus n = 3, the smallest possible two-sided exact P value was 0.10. CellChat nominated candidate myeloid-associated pathways without animal-level testing. In the same mice, 17 of 18 testable BALF analytes increased after HAdV-7 infection, whereas none of 29 testable serum analytes remained significant after correction. Conclusions Independent blood and lung datasets showed similar directions of innate immune change after HAdV infection. The contrasting BALF and serum results highlight the limits of peripheral measurements. The single-cell and CellChat results remain exploratory and require validation in larger, balanced cohorts.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Human adenovirus (HAdV) can cause severe pediatric pneumonia, but peripheral blood does not directly represent the immune response in the lung. The study aimed to characterize the innate immune responses in HAdV infection by comparing blood and lung datasets.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed two public blood transcriptome datasets alongside RNA-seq data from 13 children with HAdV infection and 10 non-infectious controls. It also included mouse lung scRNA-seq data comparing control, HAdV-3, and HAdV-7 groups with three mice per group.
analysis_en.methods: Mouse lung scRNA-seq data were compared across control, HAdV-3, and HAdV-7 groups, with three mice per group. Cell proportions and module scores used mice as biological replicates.
analysis_en.main_results: Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs. In the same mice, 17 of 18 testable BALF analytes increased after HAdV-7 infection, whereas none of 29 testable serum analytes remained significant after correction.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Independent blood and lung datasets showed similar directions of innate immune change after HAdV infection. The contrasting BALF and serum results highlight the limits of peripheral measurements.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that peripheral measurements may not fully capture the immune response in HAdV infection, emphasizing the need for localized assessments in the lung for accurate diagnosis and treatment strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: No mouse-level proportion or module-score comparison remained significant after correction; with n = 3 versus n = 3, the smallest possible two-sided exact P value was 0.10. The single-cell and CellChat results remain exploratory and require validation in larger, balanced cohorts.

papers.title_zh: 平行转录组和单细胞分析表征 免疫应答 感染中的先天 免疫应答
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Human adenovirus (HAdV) can cause severe pediatric pneumonia, but peripheral blood does not directly represent the immune response in the lung. We examined independent blood and lung datasets to define shared directions and local cellular patterns. Methods Two public blood transcriptome datasets were analyzed alongside RNA-seq data from 13 children with HAdV infection and 10 non-infectious controls. Mouse lung scRNA-seq compared control, HAdV-3, and HAdV-7 groups, with three mice per group. Cell proportions and module scores used mice as biological replicates. CellChat was performed on group-pooled cells. Serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), lung IL-1β, and infected THP-1 cells provided independent validation. Results Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs. Mild ( n = 3) and severe ( n = 10) PBMC cases overlapped in PCA, and six immune signatures had adjusted P values of 1.00. The lung atlas contained 17 populations and localized antiviral and inflammatory programs mainly to myeloid cells. Several populations were unevenly distributed among mice. No mouse-level proportion or module-score comparison remained significant after correction; with n = 3 versus n = 3, the smallest possible two-sided exact P value was 0.10. CellChat nominated candidate myeloid-associated pathways without animal-level testing. In the same mice, 17 of 18 testable BALF analytes increased after HAdV-7 infection, whereas none of 29 testable serum analytes remained significant after correction. Conclusions Independent blood and lung datasets showed similar directions of innate immune change after HAdV infection. The contrasting BALF and serum results highlight the limits of peripheral measurements. The single-cell and CellChat results remain exploratory and require validation in larger, balanced cohorts.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 可引起重症小儿肺炎,但外周血并不能直接代表肺部的 免疫应答。我们检查了独立的血液和肺部数据集,以定义共享方向和局部细胞模式。方法 对两个公共血液转录组数据集以及 13 名 HAdV 感染儿童和 10 名非感染对照儿童的 RNA-seq 数据进行分析。小鼠肺 scRNA-seq 比较了对照组、HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 组,每组三只小鼠。细胞比例和模块评分使用小鼠作为生物复制品。CellChat 在分组细胞上进行。血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液 (BALF)、肺 IL-1β 和感染的 THP-1 细胞提供了独立验证。结果 公共血液和儿科 PBMC 数据显示干扰素、炎症、TNF-α/NF-κB、IL-6/JAK/STAT3、补体和骨髓相关程序。轻度 ( n = 3) 和重度 ( n = 10) PBMC 病例在 PCA 中重叠,并且 6 个免疫特征调整后的 P 值为 1.00。肺图谱包含 17 个群体,局部 抗病毒药物 和炎症程序主要针对骨髓细胞。几个群体在小鼠之间分布不均匀。校正后,小鼠水平比例或模块分数比较不再显着;当 n = 3 与 n = 3 时,最小可能的双边精确 P 值为 0.10。CellChat 提名了候选骨髓相关通路,但未进行动物水平测试。在同一只小鼠中,HAdV-7 感染后,18 种可测试的 BALF 分析物中有 17 种增加,而 29 种可测试的血清分析物在校正后均不显着。结论 独立的血液和肺部数据集显示 HAdV 感染后先天免疫变化的相似方向。BALF 和血清结果的对比凸显了外周测量的局限性。单细胞和 CellChat 结果仍然是探索性的,需要在更大、平衡的 队列研究 中进行验证。

papers.title: A broadly applicable strategy for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of CAR-negative mesenchymal stromal cells
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (MSCs) are promising cellular vehicles for regenerative medicine and cancer gene therapy because of their immunomodulatory properties, tumor tropism, and favorable safety profile. Adenoviral vectors are attractive for genetic engineering of MSCs because they enable high transgene expression without genomic integration. However, their application to MSCs is limited by poor transduction efficiency due to low or absent expression of the coxsackievirus and adenovirus receptor (CAR) in these cells. Although cationic reagents, including polybrene, have been reported to improve adenoviral gene transfer in some cell types, efficient transduction of CAR-negative mesenchymal cells remains challenging. Results We developed a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol in which the combination of polybrene and centrifugation markedly enhanced adenoviral transduction across multiple CAR-negative mesenchymal cell types without increasing the viral dose. To determine whether improved transduction enhances therapeutic efficacy, mouse adipose tissue-derived stromal cells were transduced with an insulin-expressing adenoviral vector and transplanted into streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice. Cells transduced with polybrene-assisted spin infection significantly reduced blood glucose levels, whereas cells transduced without spin infection showed limited therapeutic efficacy. Conclusions Polybrene-assisted spin infection provides a simple and broadly applicable platform for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of MSCs and has the potential to enhance the therapeutic efficacy of engineered MSCs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of efficient adenoviral transduction in CAR-negative mesenchymal stromal cells, which are promising for regenerative medicine and cancer gene therapy due to their immunomodulatory properties and favorable safety profile.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved developing a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol to enhance adenoviral transduction in CAR-negative mesenchymal stromal cells, using mouse adipose tissue-derived stromal cells transduced with an insulin-expressing adenoviral vector and transplanted into streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol, combining polybrene with centrifugation to improve adenoviral transduction efficiency in CAR-negative mesenchymal cells without increasing the viral dose.
analysis.main_results: Cells transduced with polybrene-assisted spin infection significantly reduced blood glucose levels, whereas cells transduced without spin infection showed limited therapeutic efficacy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as demonstrating that the polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol enhances adenoviral transduction in CAR-negative mesenchymal cells, offering a novel and broadly applicable strategy for genetic engineering.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this method could improve the therapeutic potential of engineered mesenchymal stromal cells, which may have implications for the development of more effective gene therapy approaches.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on a single experimental model, which may limit generalizability, and the evidence is moderate due to the lack of broader validation across different cell types or clinical settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to improve adenoviral transduction in CAR-negative mesenchymal stromal cells, which are promising for regenerative medicine and cancer gene therapy. The researchers developed a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol that significantly enhanced transduction efficiency without increasing the viral dose. They tested this method using mouse adipose tissue-derived stromal cells transduced with an insulin-expressing adenoviral vector and transplanted into diabetic mice, observing a marked reduction in blood glucose levels compared to cells transduced without spin infection. The authors concluded that this protocol provides a simple and broadly applicable platform for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of MSCs, potentially enhancing their therapeutic efficacy. However, the study's findings are limited to a single model system, which may affect generalizability. The evidence is moderate as it lacks broader validation across different cell types or clinical applications.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决 CAR 阴性间充质基质细胞中高效腺病毒转导的挑战,由于其免疫调节特性和良好的安全性,这些细胞在再生医学和癌症基因治疗方面具有广阔的前景。

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用聚凝胺辅助旋转感染方案,将聚凝胺与离心相结合,在不增加病毒剂量的情况下提高 CAR 阴性间充质细胞中的腺病毒转导效率。

papers.title_zh: 腺病毒介导的 CAR 阴性间充质基质细胞基因工程的广泛适用策略
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (MSCs) are promising cellular vehicles for regenerative medicine and cancer gene therapy because of their immunomodulatory properties, tumor tropism, and favorable safety profile. Adenoviral vectors are attractive for genetic engineering of MSCs because they enable high transgene expression without genomic integration. However, their application to MSCs is limited by poor transduction efficiency due to low or absent expression of the coxsackievirus and adenovirus receptor (CAR) in these cells. Although cationic reagents, including polybrene, have been reported to improve adenoviral gene transfer in some cell types, efficient transduction of CAR-negative mesenchymal cells remains challenging. Results We developed a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol in which the combination of polybrene and centrifugation markedly enhanced adenoviral transduction across multiple CAR-negative mesenchymal cell types without increasing the viral dose. To determine whether improved transduction enhances therapeutic efficacy, mouse adipose tissue-derived stromal cells were transduced with an insulin-expressing adenoviral vector and transplanted into streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice. Cells transduced with polybrene-assisted spin infection significantly reduced blood glucose levels, whereas cells transduced without spin infection showed limited therapeutic efficacy. Conclusions Polybrene-assisted spin infection provides a simple and broadly applicable platform for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of MSCs and has the potential to enhance the therapeutic efficacy of engineered MSCs.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 间充质基质/干细胞(MSC)因其免疫调节特性、肿瘤趋向性和良好的安全性而成为再生医学和癌症基因治疗的有前景的细胞载体。腺病毒 媒介 对于 MSC 的基因工程很有吸引力,因为它们无需基因组整合即可实现高转基因表达。然而,由于这些细胞中柯萨奇病毒和腺病毒受体(CAR)的表达低或不表达,它们在 MSC 中的应用受到转导效率差的限制。尽管据报道,包括聚凝胺在内的阳离子试剂可以改善某些细胞类型中的腺病毒基因转移,但 CAR 阴性间充质细胞的有效转导仍然具有挑战性。结果我们开发了一种聚凝胺辅助旋转感染方案,其中聚凝胺和离心的结合显着增强了跨多种 CAR 阴性间充质细胞类型的腺病毒转导,而无需增加病毒剂量。为了确定改进的转导是否可以增强治疗效果,用表达胰岛素的腺病毒 媒介 转导小鼠脂肪组织来源的基质细胞,并将其移植到链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠中。用聚凝胺辅助的自旋感染转导的细胞显着降低了血糖水平,而未经自旋感染转导的细胞显示出有限的治疗效果。结论 Polybrene辅助旋转感染为腺病毒介导的MSCs基因工程提供了一个简单且广泛适用的平台,并有可能提高工程化MSCs的治疗效果。

papers.title: Monitoring of viral genome occurrence and persistence in municipal wastewater: a one-year study of adenovirus, polyomaviruses, and hepatitis A virus.
papers.abstract: Monitoring viruses in wastewater can provide useful information on community-level viral circulation and the persistence of viral genome concentrations after treatment. The present study investigated the occurrence of four viral targets in 72 wastewater samples over a one-year period. The results showed that at least one viral target was detected in 55 of 72 samples (76.4%). HAdV was the most frequently detected virus (48.6%), followed by JCPyV (27.8%), BKPyV (22.2%), and HAV (16.7%). Detection frequencies were generally higher in influent than effluent wastewater for all targets. JCPyV showed the clearest treatment-stage difference, decreasing from 41.7% in influent samples to 13.9% in effluent samples, while HAdV detection decreased from 61.1% in influent to 36.1% in effluent samples. Viral load concentrations were higher in influent than effluent samples for all viral targets. HAdV had nine paired quantifiable influent-effluent observations, with a median treatment-associated reduction of 0.63 log 10 GC/L. Seasonal analysis showed the highest HAdV detection during winter (77.8%), while JCPyV was also most frequently detected in winter (38.9%); HAV detection was more sporadic and occurred mainly during winter and spring. Multi-virus detection occurred in 29.2%, most commonly involving HAdV with JCPyV or BKPyV. Infectivity assessment of 20 HAdV-positive samples showed cytopathic effect in 11 samples; 10 met the predefined combined criterion of CPE plus a ≥ 1-log 10 post-culture increase, with CPE-positive samples showing a median post-culture increase of 1.29 log 10 GC/L. The study supports the assessment of wastewater viral surveillance as a useful complementary tool for environmental virology and public health monitoring.

analysis.methods: The study involved the collection and analysis of wastewater samples to detect viral genomes, with specific attention to the presence and concentration of human adenoviruses and their persistence after treatment.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of wastewater monitoring for public health surveillance, offering insights into viral persistence and seasonal trends in human adenovirus prevalence.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's generalizability may be limited due to the specific wastewater sources and the lack of detailed information on the infectivity of detected viruses, though the evidence is strong for the observed trends in viral detection and persistence.

The present study investigated the occurrence of four viral targets in 72 wastewater samples over a one-year period. The results showed that at least one viral target was detected in 55 of 72 samples (76.4%). HAdV was the most frequently detected virus (48.6%), followed by JCPyV (27.8%), BKPyV (22.2%), and HAV (16.7%). Detection frequencies were generally higher in influent than effluent wastewater for all targets. JCPyV showed the clearest treatment-stage difference, decreasing from 41.7% in influent samples to 13.9% in effluent samples, while HAdV detection decreased from 61.1% in influent to 36.1% in effluent samples. Viral load concentrations were higher in influent than effluent samples for all viral targets. HAdV had nine paired quantifiable influent-effluent observations, with a median treatment-associated reduction of 0.63 log 10 GC/L. Seasonal analysis showed the highest HAdV detection during winter (77.8%), while JCPyV was also most frequently detected in winter (38.9%); HAV detection was more sporadic and occurred mainly during winter and spring. Multi-virus detection occurred in 29.2%, most commonly involving HAdV with JCPyV or BKPyV. Infectivity assessment of 20 HAdV-positive samples showed cytopathic effect in 11 samples; 10 met the predefined combined criterion of CPE plus a ≥ 1-log 10 post-culture increase, with CPE-positive samples showing a median post-culture increase of 1.29 log 10 GC/L. The study supports the assessment of wastewater viral surveillance as a useful complementary tool for environmental virology and public health monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 监测废水中的病毒可以提供有关社区水平病毒循环以及 基因组 病毒 基因组 浓度在 治疗 后持续存在的有用信息。本研究调查了一年内 72 个废水样本中四种病毒目标的出现情况。结果显示,72 个样本中有 55 个(76.4%)检测到至少一种病毒靶标。HAdV 是最常检测到的病毒 (48.6%),其次是 JCPyV (27.8%)、BKPyV (22.2%) 和 HAV (16.7%)。对于所有目标,进水废水中的检测频率通常高于出水废水中的检测频率。JCPyV 显示出最明显的 治疗 阶段差异,从进水样品中的 41.7% 下降到出水样品中的 13.9%,而 HAdV 检测从进水样品中的 61.1% 下降到出水样品中的 36.1%。对于所有病毒目标,进水样品中的病毒载量浓度均高于出水样品中的病毒载量浓度。HAdV 有九对可量化的进水-出水观察结果,与 治疗 相关的中位减少量为 0.63 log 10 GC/L。季节分析显示,HAdV 在冬季检出率最高(77.8%),而 JCPyV 在冬季检出率也最高(38.9%);甲型肝炎病毒检出较为零星,主要发生在冬春季节。多种病毒检测发生率为 29.2%,最常见的是 HAdV 与 JCPyV 或 BKPyV。对 20 个 HAdV 阳性样本的感染性评估显示 11 个样本出现细胞病变效应;10 符合 CPE 加上 ≥ 1-log 10 培养后增加的预定义组合标准,CPE 阳性样本显示培养后中位增加为 1.29 log 10 GC/L。该研究支持对废水病毒 监测 的评估,将其作为环境病毒学和公共卫生监测的有用补充工具。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 人腺病毒 在城市废水中的出现和持续性,以了解社区水平的病毒循环和废水 治疗 处理的有效性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对从城市废水系统收集的 72 个废水样本中的四个病毒目标进行了为期一年的调查。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究涉及收集和分析废水样本以检测病毒 基因组,特别关注 人腺病毒 的存在和浓度及其在 治疗 后的持续存在。
analysis_zh.main_results: 72 个样本中的 55 个样本中至少检测到一种病毒靶点 (76.4%),其中 HAdV 是最常检测到的病毒 (48.6%),其次是 JCPyV (27.8%)、BKPyV (22.2%) 和 HAV (16.7%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了废水 监测 作为跟踪病毒循环和评估 治疗 功效的补充工具的潜力,特别是对于 人腺病毒。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持使用废水监测来促进公共卫生 监测,提供对 人腺病毒 患病率 中病毒持续性和季节性趋势的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管有强有力的证据表明观察到的病毒检测和持久性趋势,但由于特定的废水源和缺乏有关检测到的病毒的感染性的详细信息,该研究的普遍性可能受到限制。

papers.title: Epididymo-Orchitis Associated With Disseminated Adenovirus Infection in a Kidney Transplant Recipient.
papers.abstract: Human adenovirus (HAdV) is a nonenveloped double-stranded DNA virus that causes self-limited illness in immunocompetent hosts but may produce severe, occasionally fatal disease in solid organ transplant recipients, with a clinical spectrum ranging from asymptomatic viremia to disseminated infection and allograft loss with increased morbidity and mortality. We present a rare case of disseminated HAdV infection diagnosed in a renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression, who presented with mild upper respiratory symptoms of coryza and subjective fever, followed by scrotal pain and swelling. Ultrasound showed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was positive. In the absence of virological or histological confirmation, the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial; taken together with the temporal sequence and the exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, however, HAdV is the most probable cause, and the patient was managed as probable disseminated HAdV disease. Immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy; symptoms resolved gradually with recovery of allograft function, and repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative. To our knowledge, epididymo-orchitis has not previously been reported as a manifestation of HAdV disease in a kidney transplant recipient. Our case illustrates the extent of adenoviral disease after transplantation, the interpretive difficulty of attributing causation on the basis of molecular detection alone, and the adequacy of immunosuppression reduction as sole therapy in mild disease.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to highlight the potential for human adenovirus (HAdV) to cause severe disseminated infection in immunocompromised individuals, particularly kidney transplant recipients, where it can lead to complications such as epididymo-orchitis and allograft loss.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report describing a single renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression who developed disseminated HAdV infection, presenting with mild upper respiratory symptoms followed by scrotal pain and swelling.
analysis.methods: Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was used to detect HAdV, and immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy as the management approach.
analysis.main_results: Ultrasound revealed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial, but given the temporal sequence and exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, HAdV is the most probable cause of the disseminated infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for vigilance in recognizing HAdV as a potential cause of severe disease in immunocompromised transplant recipients and highlight the importance of reducing immunosuppression in managing mild cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the absence of virological or histological confirmation, and the interpretation is based on molecular detection and clinical context, which may not definitively establish causation. The evidence is moderate due to the case report nature.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare instance of disseminated human adenovirus (HAdV) infection in a kidney transplant recipient, leading to epididymo-orchitis and scrotal swelling. The patient had mild upper respiratory symptoms initially, followed by scrotal pain and swelling. PCR testing confirmed HAdV presence, and symptoms resolved after reducing immunosuppression without antiviral therapy. The case highlights the potential severity of HAdV in immunocompromised individuals and the challenges of attributing causation based solely on molecular detection. It also underscores the effectiveness of immunosuppression reduction in managing mild HAdV disease. The study is limited by the lack of virological or histological confirmation, and the interpretation relies on clinical context and exclusion of other pathogens, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究旨在强调 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 在​​免疫功能低下的个体中引起严重播散性感染的可能性,特别是肾移植受者,它可能导致附睾睾丸炎和同种异体移植物丢失等并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是 病例报告 的研究,描述了一名接受维持免疫抑制的肾移植受者发生播散性 HAdV 感染,出现轻度上呼吸道症状,随后出现阴囊疼痛和肿胀。

elements_zh.main_results: 超声检查显示双侧附睾睾丸炎和弥漫性阴囊水肿。尿液分析、培养以及衣原体和淋病检测均为阴性。出院后 1 周在门诊复查时重复血液 HAdV PCR 结果为阴性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to highlight the potential for human adenovirus (HAdV) to cause severe disseminated infection in immunocompromised individuals, particularly kidney transplant recipients, where it can lead to complications such as epididymo-orchitis and allograft loss.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report describing a single renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression who developed disseminated HAdV infection, presenting with mild upper respiratory symptoms followed by scrotal pain and swelling.
analysis_en.methods: Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was used to detect HAdV, and immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy as the management approach.
analysis_en.main_results: Ultrasound revealed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial, but given the temporal sequence and exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, HAdV is the most probable cause of the disseminated infection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for vigilance in recognizing HAdV as a potential cause of severe disease in immunocompromised transplant recipients and highlight the importance of reducing immunosuppression in managing mild cases.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the absence of virological or histological confirmation, and the interpretation is based on molecular detection and clinical context, which may not definitively establish causation. The evidence is moderate due to the case report nature.

papers.title_zh: 肾移植受者中与播散性腺病毒感染相关的附睾睾丸炎。
papers.source_body_en: Human adenovirus (HAdV) is a nonenveloped double-stranded DNA virus that causes self-limited illness in immunocompetent hosts but may produce severe, occasionally fatal disease in solid organ transplant recipients, with a clinical spectrum ranging from asymptomatic viremia to disseminated infection and allograft loss with increased morbidity and mortality. We present a rare case of disseminated HAdV infection diagnosed in a renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression, who presented with mild upper respiratory symptoms of coryza and subjective fever, followed by scrotal pain and swelling. Ultrasound showed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was positive. In the absence of virological or histological confirmation, the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial; taken together with the temporal sequence and the exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, however, HAdV is the most probable cause, and the patient was managed as probable disseminated HAdV disease. Immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy; symptoms resolved gradually with recovery of allograft function, and repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative. To our knowledge, epididymo-orchitis has not previously been reported as a manifestation of HAdV disease in a kidney transplant recipient. Our case illustrates the extent of adenoviral disease after transplantation, the interpretive difficulty of attributing causation on the basis of molecular detection alone, and the adequacy of immunosuppression reduction as sole therapy in mild disease.
papers.abstract_zh: 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是一种无包膜双链 DNA 病毒,可在免疫功能正常的 宿主 中引起自限性疾病,但可能在实体器官移植受者中产生严重的、偶尔致命的疾病,其临床谱包括无症状病毒血症、播散性感染和同种异体移植物丢失,发病率增加和 死亡率。我们报告了一个在维持免疫抑制的肾移植受者中诊断出的播散性 HAdV 感染的罕见病例,该患者出现轻微的鼻炎和主观发热等上呼吸道症状,随后出现阴囊疼痛和肿胀。超声检查显示双侧附睾睾丸炎和弥漫性阴囊水肿。尿液分析、培养以及衣原体和淋病检测均为阴性。血液和呼吸道分泌物的腺病毒聚合酶链反应(PCR)呈阳性。在缺乏病毒学或组织学证实的情况下,HAdV 与阴囊检查结果之间的关联是间接的;然而,结合时间顺序并排除其他细菌和病毒原因,HAdV 是最可能的原因,患者被视为可能播散性 HAdV 疾病。无需 抗病毒药物 治疗即可减轻免疫抑制;随着同种异体移植功能的恢复,症状逐渐缓解,出院后 1 周门诊复查时重复血液 HAdV PCR 呈阴性。据我们所知,附睾睾丸炎此前尚未被报道为肾移植受者中 HAdV 疾病的表现。我们的案例说明了移植后腺病毒疾病的严重程度、仅根据分子检测来解释因果关系的困难,以及减少免疫抑制作为轻度疾病的唯一疗法的充分性。

papers.title: Adenoviral vectored porcine interferon omega-5 elicits strong antiviral activity and sterile immunity against foot-and-mouth disease in swine
papers.abstract: Abstract Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a high economic consequence disease of cloven-hoofed animals, necessitating effective countermeasures for control. Outbreak prevention and control is supported mainly by inactivated vaccines; however, a 7-day period is required for the vaccine to confer protective immunity. In an effort to improve the protective window, biotherapeutic agents such as interferons (IFNs) have been explored for their potent antiviral functions against FMD virus (FMDV). In silico analysis of porcine IFN α1 and porcine IFN ω5 demonstrated distinct biochemical differences that could affect receptor binding and downstream signaling. In this study, we constructed and evaluated an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic. In porcine cells, Ad5-pIFN ω5 induced antiviral IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) and demonstrates antiviral activity against FMDV. In vivo, 12 pigs divided into three different groups were inoculated with Ad5-pIFN ω5 (1 × 10 8 , 1 × 10 9 , and 1 × 10 10 pfu) and challenged alongside a control group with FMDV O1 Manisa 24 h post-inoculation. The highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected swine against challenge, suggesting sterile immunity, which is defined as no detection of viral replication in serum or nasal swabs and a lack of neutralizing antibody titers. Further analysis of innate immunity by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) revealed detectable induction of type I IFN in serum from animals receiving the highest dose, which correlated with protection. These findings demonstrate that pIFN ω5 is a potent type I IFN that can rapidly and effectively protect swine from FMD.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in swine. FMD is a significant economic threat to cloven-hoofed animals, and current vaccines require a 7-day period to confer protective immunity. The researchers explored biotherapeutic agents like interferons to shorten this protective window. In silico analysis revealed biochemical differences between porcine IFN α1 and ω5, which could influence their antiviral activity. In vivo experiments showed that the highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected pigs against FMDV O1 Manisa challenge, indicating sterile immunity. The study also found that the highest dose induced detectable type I IFN in serum, correlating with protection. These results suggest that pIFN ω5 is a potent antiviral agent with potential for rapid FMD prevention. However, the study is limited by its small sample size and use of a single virus strain, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 口蹄疫(FMD)是偶蹄动物的一种高经济后果疾病,需要采取有效的防治措施。该研究旨在探索新型生物治疗药物,以改善口蹄疫的保护窗口。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了编码猪 IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) 的腺病毒 媒介 作为一种新型生物治疗药物。在体内,12头猪被分为三个不同的组,并以不同剂量接种Ad5-pIFN ω5,然后在接种后24小时与对照组一起用FMDV O1 Manisa进行攻击。
elements_zh.methods: 对猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 进行计算机分析,以确定影响受体结合和下游信号传导的生化差异。通过酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对先天免疫的进一步分析表明,接受最高剂量的动物血清中可检测到 I 型干扰素的诱导。
elements_zh.main_results: 猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 的计算机分析显示出明显的生化差异,可能影响受体结合和下游信号传导。最高剂量的 Ad5-pIFN ω5 完全保护猪免受攻击,表明无菌免疫。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,pIFN ω5 是一种有效的 I 型 IFN,可以快速有效地保护猪免受口蹄疫感染。本研究介绍了 Ad5-pIFN ω5 作为一种新型生物治疗药物,具有预防口蹄疫的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发针对FMD的快速有效的生物治疗干预措施奠定了基础,这可以显着改善猪群的暴发预防和控制策略。

papers.title_zh: 腺病毒载体猪干扰素 omega-5 在猪中引发强 抗病毒药物 活性和针对口蹄疫的无菌免疫力
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a high economic consequence disease of cloven-hoofed animals, necessitating effective countermeasures for control. Outbreak prevention and control is supported mainly by inactivated vaccines; however, a 7-day period is required for the vaccine to confer protective immunity. In an effort to improve the protective window, biotherapeutic agents such as interferons (IFNs) have been explored for their potent antiviral functions against FMD virus (FMDV). In silico analysis of porcine IFN α1 and porcine IFN ω5 demonstrated distinct biochemical differences that could affect receptor binding and downstream signaling. In this study, we constructed and evaluated an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic. In porcine cells, Ad5-pIFN ω5 induced antiviral IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) and demonstrates antiviral activity against FMDV. In vivo, 12 pigs divided into three different groups were inoculated with Ad5-pIFN ω5 (1 × 10 8 , 1 × 10 9 , and 1 × 10 10 pfu) and challenged alongside a control group with FMDV O1 Manisa 24 h post-inoculation. The highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected swine against challenge, suggesting sterile immunity, which is defined as no detection of viral replication in serum or nasal swabs and a lack of neutralizing antibody titers. Further analysis of innate immunity by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) revealed detectable induction of type I IFN in serum from animals receiving the highest dose, which correlated with protection. These findings demonstrate that pIFN ω5 is a potent type I IFN that can rapidly and effectively protect swine from FMD.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 口蹄疫(FMD)是偶蹄动物的一种高经济后果疾病,需要采取有效的防治措施。暴发防控主要由灭活的疫苗支持;然而,疫苗 需要 7 天的时间才能赋予保护性免疫力。为了改善保护窗口,干扰素 (IFN) 等生物治疗药物具有针对口蹄疫病毒 (FMDV) 的强大 抗病毒药物 功能。猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 的计算机分析显示出明显的生化差异,可能影响受体结合和下游信号传导。在本研究中,我们构建并评估了编码猪 IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) 的腺病毒 媒介 作为一种新型生物治疗药物。在猪细胞中,Ad5-pIFN ω5 诱导 抗病毒药物 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG),并表现出 抗病毒药物 对抗 FMDV 的活性。在体内,分为三个不同组的 12 头猪接种了 Ad5-pIFN ω5(1 × 10 8 、1 × 10 9 和 1 × 10 10 pfu),并与对照组一起在接种后 24 小时用 FMDV O1 Manisa 进行攻击。最高剂量的 Ad5-pIFN ω5 完全保护猪免受攻击,表明无菌免疫,其定义为在血清或鼻拭子中未检测到病毒复制并且缺乏中和抗体滴度。通过酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对先天免疫的进一步分析表明,接受最高剂量的动物血清中可检测到 I 型 IFN 的诱导,这与保护作用相关。这些研究结果表明,pIFN ω5 是一种有效的 I 型 IFN,可以快速有效地保护猪免受口蹄疫感染。

papers.title: Respiratory pathogen spectrum, peripheral blood immunophenotype, and clinical characteristics of hospitalized children with Kawasaki disease complicated by acute respiratory tract infection: a retrospective cohort study
papers.abstract: Objective To systematically delineate the respiratory microbiological landscape, peripheral immunophenotypic dynamics, and clinical trajectories in hospitalized children with Kawasaki disease (KD) complicated by acute respiratory tract infection (ARTI), and to evaluate accessible creatine kinase (CK)-normalized ratio models for early differential diagnosis. Methods This retrospective study analyzed a discovery cohort of 139 ARTI-complicated KD cases and 600 uncomplicated ARTI controls using targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) and flow cytometry. Novel CK-normalized ratio models were developed and evaluated in an independent validation cohort (156 KD and 203 controls). Results High respiratory pathogen co-detection was observed in hospitalized children across both cohorts (85.6% in KD vs. 85.3% in ARTI controls). Multivariate and specimen-stratified analyses revealed that human adenovirus (HAdV) was selectively enriched in the lower respiratory tract (BALF: adjusted OR = 3.321, 95% CI: 1.324–8.331, P = 0.011). KD patients exhibited marked peripheral lymphocyte depletion (ALC: 2.82 vs. 3.68 × 10 9 /L, P < 0.001), CD4 + T-cell reduction, and a proportional increase in CD19 + B cells (all P < 0.05). Leveraging paradoxical CK suppression during hyper-inflammation, CK-normalized ratio models consistently yielded higher numerical AUCs compared to solitary biomarkers; in the independent validation cohort, PCT/CK achieved AUCs of 0.870 (95% CI: 0.832–0.909) for total KD and 0.897 (95% CI: 0.860–0.935) for complete KD (cKD), while CRP/CK achieved an AUC of 0.835 (95% CI: 0.770–0.900, specificity = 90.64%) for incomplete KD (iKD). Clinically, KD patients had a lower overall respiratory complication rate (36.7% vs. 47.2%) but marked extrapulmonary burdens, including liver injury (19.4% vs. 3.7%), and coronary artery lesions (26.6%, with coronary artery aneurysms [Z ≥ 2.5] in 20.1%), resulting in longer stays and higher healthcare costs (all P < 0.05). Conclusion ARTI-complicated KD involves a distinct immunopathological process potentially associated with deep lower respiratory HAdV infection. The independently validated PCT/CK and CRP/CK models offer accessible, cost-effective adjunctive tools to assist in the in-hospital differential diagnosis of ARTI-complicated KD. Clinical management requires multidisciplinary balancing of intensive anti-inflammatory therapy with infection control.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study investigated the respiratory microbiological landscape, immunophenotypic dynamics, and clinical characteristics of hospitalized children with Kawasaki disease (KD) complicated by acute respiratory tract infection (ARTI). The study compared 139 KD cases with 600 ARTI controls and validated findings in an independent cohort of 156 KD and 203 controls. Using targeted next-generation sequencing and flow cytometry, the research identified high respiratory pathogen co-detection in both groups, with human adenovirus (HAdV) selectively enriched in the lower respiratory tract. However, the retrospective design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the evidence, though the models show moderate validity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在系统地描绘川崎病(KD)并发急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)住院儿童的呼吸道微生物状况、外周免疫表型动态和临床轨迹,弥补关于川崎病和呼吸道病原体之间相互作用的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性 队列研究 研究分析了 139 名 ARTI 并发 KD 病例和 600 名不复杂 ARTI 对照的 队列研究 发现,并进行了包括 156 名 KD 和 203 名对照的独立验证 队列研究。该研究在多个中心进行,重点关注住院儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用靶向下一代测序(tNGS)和流式细胞术来评估呼吸道病原体和免疫表型特征。在独立验证 队列研究 中开发并评估了新型 CK 归一化比率模型。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 队列研究 中观察到高呼吸道病原体共同检测(KD 中为 85.6%,ARTI 对照中为 85.3%)。人腺病毒 (HAdV) 在​​下呼吸道选择性富集,调整后的 OR 为 3.321(95% CI:1.324–8.331,P = 0.011)。KD 患者外周淋巴细胞明显减少,CD19 + B 细胞成比例增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,ARTI 并发的 KD 涉及一种独特的免疫病理学过程,可能与下呼吸道深部 HAdV 感染有关。与单独的生物标志物相比,CK 归一化比率模型显示出更高的诊断准确性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,HAdV 可能在 ARTI 并发 KD 的 发病机制 中发挥作用,为临床环境中的靶向 监测 和差异化 诊断 提供了潜在的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制。然而,独立验证的 CK 归一化比率模型对其微分 诊断 的实用性提供了中等的信心。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在 队列研究 中观察到高呼吸道病原体共同检测(KD 中为 85.6%,ARTI 对照中为 85.3%)。人腺病毒 (HAdV) 在​​下呼吸道选择性富集,调整后的 OR 为 3.321(95% CI:1.324–8.331,P = 0.011)。KD 患者外周淋巴细胞明显减少,CD19 + B 细胞成比例增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,ARTI 并发的 KD 涉及一种独特的免疫病理学过程,可能与下呼吸道深部 HAdV 感染有关。与单独的生物标志物相比,CK 归一化比率模型显示出更高的诊断准确性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,HAdV 可能在 ARTI 并发 KD 的 发病机制 中发挥作用,为临床环境中的靶向 监测 和差异化 诊断 提供了潜在的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制。然而,独立验证的 CK 归一化比率模型对其微分 诊断 的实用性提供了中等的信心。

papers.title: Temporal dynamics of respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients in Shanghai, 2019–2023: a multi-center longitudinal surveillance study
papers.abstract: COVID-19 greatly reshaped the epidemiology of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.This study explored temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic. A retrospective multi-center observational study was performed across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China (2019–2023). Hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). We stratified the study period into pre-pandemic (2019), pandemic (2020–2022), and post-pandemic (2023) phases for comparative analysis. In total, 4738 participants were enrolled. The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) ( P <0.001). A novel classification of four distinct temporal trends was established: (1) decline-resurgence for influenza virus (IFV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( M. pneumoniae ), Bordetella pertussis ( B. pertussis ), and human bocavirus (HBoV); (2) sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus (HPIV), human coronavirus (HCoV), human adenovirus (HAdV), human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), and Legionella pneumophila ( L. pneumophila ); (3) transient peak for human metapneumovirus (HMPV); (4) continuous increase for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). IFV, HRV/EV, and HCoV consistently ranked top five across all periods. pneumoniae was the dominant pathogen (33.65%) in patients aged 15–44 years. Seasonal peaks of IFV and RSV were substantially reshaped in the post-pandemic period. The co-infection rate was 1.14% (54/4738), with IFV- M. pneumoniae was the most combination (20.37%). Respiratory pathogen circulation patterns changed substantially from 2019 to 2023. Persistent multi-pathogen surveillance is required to guard against single-pathogen outbreaks and concurrent multi-pathogen epidemics.

papers.title_zh: 2019-2023年上海成人SARI患者呼吸道病原体时间动态:多中心纵向监测研究
papers.source_body_en: COVID-19 greatly reshaped the epidemiology of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.This study explored temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic. A retrospective multi-center observational study was performed across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China (2019–2023). Hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). We stratified the study period into pre-pandemic (2019), pandemic (2020–2022), and post-pandemic (2023) phases for comparative analysis. In total, 4738 participants were enrolled. The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) ( P <0.001). A novel classification of four distinct temporal trends was established: (1) decline-resurgence for influenza virus (IFV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( M. pneumoniae ), Bordetella pertussis ( B. pertussis ), and human bocavirus (HBoV); (2) sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus (HPIV), human coronavirus (HCoV), human adenovirus (HAdV), human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), and Legionella pneumophila ( L. pneumophila ); (3) transient peak for human metapneumovirus (HMPV); (4) continuous increase for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). IFV, HRV/EV, and HCoV consistently ranked top five across all periods. pneumoniae was the dominant pathogen (33.65%) in patients aged 15–44 years. Seasonal peaks of IFV and RSV were substantially reshaped in the post-pandemic period. The co-infection rate was 1.14% (54/4738), with IFV- M. pneumoniae was the most combination (20.37%). Respiratory pathogen circulation patterns changed substantially from 2019 to 2023. Persistent multi-pathogen surveillance is required to guard against single-pathogen outbreaks and concurrent multi-pathogen epidemics.
papers.abstract_zh: COVID-19 极大地重塑了严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 的 流行病学,但多病原体循环的长期变化仍知之甚少。本研究探讨了成人 SARI 患者在大流行之前、期间和之后常见呼吸道病原体的时间模式。对中国上海七家哨点医院(2019-2023)进行了回顾性多中心观察研究。使用实时聚合酶链反应 (RT-PCR) 对年龄≥ 15 岁的住院 SARI 患者进行了 12 种呼吸道病原体(22 种亚型)检测。我们将研究时期分为大流行前(2019年)、大流行(2020-2022年)和大流行后(2023年)三个阶段进行比较分析。总共有 4738 名参与者参加。总体病原检出率从疫情前期(2019年)的30.26%下降至疫情期间(2020-2022年)的16.50%,随后反弹至疫情后期(2023年)的20.07%( P <0.001)。建立了四种不同时间趋势的新分类:(1)流感病毒(IFV)、肺炎支原体(M.pneumoniae)、百日咳博德特氏菌(B.pertussis)和人博卡病毒(HBoV)的下降-复苏;(2)人副流感病毒(HPIV)、人冠状病毒(HCoV)、人腺病毒(HAdV)、人鼻病毒/肠道病毒(HRV/EV)和嗜肺军团菌(L. pneumophila)持续下降;(3)人偏肺病毒(HMPV)瞬时峰;(4)呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)持续升高。IFV、HRV/EV 和 HCoV 在所有时期均排名前五。肺炎链球菌是15-44岁患者的主要病原体(33.65%)。IFV 和 RSV 的季节性峰值在大流行后时期大幅重塑。合并感染率为1.14%(54/4738),其中以IFV-肺炎支原体合并感染最多(20.37%)。从 2019 年到 2023 年,呼吸道病原体循环模式发生了很大变化。需要持续的多病原体 监测 来防范单一病原体 暴发 和并发的多病原体流行。

papers.title: Risk of respiratory infections in closed communities: multi-dimensional risk assessment and integrated surveillance in a nursing home and a prison (Stell-ARI project)
papers.abstract: Viral Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) are particularly relevant for people living in closed and vulnerable communities. The Stell-ARI Project aimed to design and apply a multi-dimensional framework integrating environmental risk assessment (based on building structure and management, resident population characteristics, indoor air quality (IAQ), and microbiological contamination of air and surfaces) with wastewater-based and clinical surveillance for SARS-CoV-2, Human Adenovirus (HAdV), Influenza Virus A (IVA) and B (IVB), Respiratory Syncytial Virus A (RSVA) and B (RSVB). This system was applied in two pilot institutional communities: a nursing home and a prison. The study design included questionnaire surveys of facility managers, residents and workers alongside environmental monitoring of chemical and microbial contaminants. Domain-specific and global risk scores were calculated. Scores were lower in the nursing home than in the prison for building structure and management (3 vs. 13) and resident population characteristics (3.4 vs. The chemical air risk score showed similar differences (1.3 vs. 3.0) and the two settings also differed in their indoor pollutant profiles. The microbiological air and surface risk score was also better in nursing home (4.0 vs 5.0). In both settings, a COVID-19 cluster was detected and SARS-CoV-2 and HAdV were found in air and surface samples, as well as in wastewater, not only in coincidence with clinical cases, but throughout the monitoring period, with a higher frequency in nursing home. In conclusion, this novel multi-dimensional structured approach, although needing further validation, represents a potential operational tool to support ARIs surveillance, prevention and control in closed and vulnerable institutional communities.

papers.title_zh: 封闭社区呼吸道感染风险:疗养院和监狱的多维度风险评估和综合监测(Stell-ARI项目)
papers.source_body_en: Viral Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) are particularly relevant for people living in closed and vulnerable communities. The Stell-ARI Project aimed to design and apply a multi-dimensional framework integrating environmental risk assessment (based on building structure and management, resident population characteristics, indoor air quality (IAQ), and microbiological contamination of air and surfaces) with wastewater-based and clinical surveillance for SARS-CoV-2, Human Adenovirus (HAdV), Influenza Virus A (IVA) and B (IVB), Respiratory Syncytial Virus A (RSVA) and B (RSVB). This system was applied in two pilot institutional communities: a nursing home and a prison. The study design included questionnaire surveys of facility managers, residents and workers alongside environmental monitoring of chemical and microbial contaminants. Domain-specific and global risk scores were calculated. Scores were lower in the nursing home than in the prison for building structure and management (3 vs. 13) and resident population characteristics (3.4 vs. The chemical air risk score showed similar differences (1.3 vs. 3.0) and the two settings also differed in their indoor pollutant profiles. The microbiological air and surface risk score was also better in nursing home (4.0 vs 5.0). In both settings, a COVID-19 cluster was detected and SARS-CoV-2 and HAdV were found in air and surface samples, as well as in wastewater, not only in coincidence with clinical cases, but throughout the monitoring period, with a higher frequency in nursing home. In conclusion, this novel multi-dimensional structured approach, although needing further validation, represents a potential operational tool to support ARIs surveillance, prevention and control in closed and vulnerable institutional communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 病毒性急性呼吸道感染(ARI)与生活在封闭和脆弱社区的人们尤其相关。Stell-ARI项目旨在设计和应用一个多维框架,将环境风险评估(基于建筑结构和管理、居民人口特征、室内空气质量(IAQ)以及空气和表面的微生物污染)与基于废水和临床的监测相结合,用于SARS-CoV-2、人腺病毒(HAdV)、流感病毒A(IVA)和B(IVB)、呼吸道合胞病毒A (RSVA) 和 B (RSVB)。该系统在两个试点机构社区得到应用:疗养院和监狱。研究设计包括对设施管理人员、居民和工人进行问卷调查,以及对化学和微生物污染物的环境监测。计算了特定领域和全局风险评分。疗养院的建筑结构和管理(3 vs. 13)和居民人口特征(3.4 vs. 3.4 vs.)的得分均低于监狱。化学空气风险评分显示出相似的差异(1.3 vs. 3.0),两种环境的室内污染物特征也存在差异。疗养院的微生物空气和表面风险评分也更好(4.0 vs 5.0)。在这两种环境中,均检测到了 COVID-19 簇以及 SARS-CoV-2 和 HAdV在空气和地表样本以及废水中都发现了这种病毒,不仅与临床病例相符,而且在整个监测期间,在疗养院中出现的频率更高。总之,这种新颖的多维结构化方法虽然需要进一步验证,但却是支持 ARIs 监测、封闭和脆弱机构社区预防和控制的潜在操作工具。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Saturday, November 21, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Biology Adenovirus Infection Shows Parallel Immune Pathways but Divergent Lung and Serum Responses by November 21, 2026 in Biology Reading Time: 2 mins read 0 Adenovirus Infection Shows Parallel Immune Pathways but Divergent Lung and Serum Responses Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram Independent analyses of blood and lung samples reveal that human adenovirus infection triggers parallel innate immune pathways across tissues while producing starkly different local and systemic protein responses, according to research published in Virology Journal. Human adenovirus can cause severe pediatric pneumonia, yet clinicians and researchers face challenges because peripheral blood measurements do not directly mirror immune activity occurring inside the lungs. To explore these differences, investigators evaluated independent blood and lung transcriptomic profiles to identify shared immunological directions alongside local cellular behaviors. The research team evaluated two public blood transcriptome datasets in parallel with newly generated RNA sequencing data from thirteen pediatric patients with human adenovirus infection and ten non-infectious controls. In addition, scientists established a mouse lung single-cell RNA sequencing atlas comparing uninfected control animals with mice infected by human adenovirus type 3 or human adenovirus type 7, utilizing three mice per experimental cohort. Across the public blood datasets and pediatric peripheral blood mononuclear cell profiles, the researchers identified prominent activation of interferon, inflammatory, complement, and myeloid-associated signaling cascades. These shared transcriptional shifts also encompassed tumor necrosis factor alpha via NF-kappaB and interleukin-6 via JAK and STAT3 pathways. However, clinical stratification in the pediatric cohort revealed notable boundaries. In principal component analysis, profiles from three mild pediatric cases overlapped with ten severe cases, and six distinct immune signatures yielded adjusted P values of 1.00, demonstrating no statistically discernible transcriptomic separation between disease severities. Within the murine lung atlas, researchers cataloged seventeen distinct cell populations and localized antiviral and inflammatory programs predominantly to myeloid lineages. Because several cell subsets exhibited uneven distributions across individual animals, no mouse-level cellular proportions or module scores retained statistical significance following multiple testing correction, constrained by the cohort size of three mice per group where the minimum possible two-sided exact P value was 0.10. Computational CellChat analyses nominated potential myeloid-associated communication pathways across group-pooled cells without animal-level statistical validation. Complementary protein measurements further underscored the divergence between respiratory and systemic compartments, as seventeen of eighteen testable bronchoalveolar lavage fluid analytes rose following adenovirus type 7 infection, whereas none of twenty-nine testable serum analytes retained significance after correction. Additional independent validation experiments incorporated lung interleukin-1 beta evaluations alongside infected THP-1 cell assays. The authors concluded that while systemic and pulmonary compartments share overall directional shifts in innate immune signaling, pronounced differences between lavage fluid and serum highlight the interpretive limits of peripheral blood testing, leaving single-cell cellular dynamics as exploratory hypotheses requiring larger, balanced cohorts. news.title_zh: 腺病毒感染显示出平行的免疫途径,但肺部和血清反应不同

news.content_zh: 2026 年 11 月 21 日发表在《病毒学杂志》上的一项研究表明,人腺病毒 感染会激活血液和肺组织中平行的先天免疫途径,但会导致不同的局部和全身蛋白质反应。研究人员进行的这项研究分析了两个公共血液数据集的转录组图谱以及来自 13 名 人腺病毒 感染儿科患者和 10 名非感染对照者新生成的 RNA 测序数据。此外,还创建了小鼠肺单细胞 RNA 测序图谱,将未感染的对照与感染 HAdV-3 或 HAdV-7 的小鼠进行比较。研究结果表明,虽然干扰素、炎症、补体和骨髓相关信号级联在组织间共享,但支气管肺泡灌洗液和血清分析物之间的差异强调了使用外周血测量来推断肺部免疫活性的局限性。作者强调,这些结果是探索性的,需要更大、平衡的 队列研究 进行进一步验证。

The investigation, conducted as part of the Stell-ARI project by researchers affiliated with the University of Pisa and collaborating institutions, tracked viral acute respiratory infections alongside chemical and microbial environmental indicators. The pilot study demonstrated that multidimensional screening can capture complex transmission factors across disparate closed communities, where residents face prolonged indoor exposure and elevated risks of pathogen transmission. Closed and semi-closed institutional facilities present unique challenges for respiratory disease control because formal operational routines, crowded quarters, and shared indoor amenities can amplify infectious spread. To capture these varied influences, the research team designed a structured framework spanning four primary evaluation domains: physical building structure and operational management, resident population characteristics, chemical indoor air quality, and microbiological contamination of indoor air and contact surfaces. Alongside this baseline and environmental scoring, the protocol incorporated weekly facility-level wastewater surveillance for key viral targets—including SARS-CoV-2, human adenovirus, influenza viruses A and B, and respiratory syncytial viruses A and B—paired with active clinical monitoring conducted by facility medical staff. The pilot fieldwork examined two contrasting facilities in Italy: a nursing home providing medium-complexity care for older adults monitored between November 2023 and February 2025, and a remand prison housing individuals serving short sentences or awaiting trial monitored between December 2023 and December 2024. Questionnaires administered to facility directors scored 16 structural and management criteria across four subdomains: physical structure and spatial density, ventilation and microclimate regulation, occupant behaviors, and sanitation practices. Each identified risk condition added one point to the unweighted score, categorizing facilities on a scale from very low to very high risk. Discover more infections Infection infection Check Symptoms infectious Evaluation of physical structures and management revealed substantial operational contrasts between the two pilot environments. The nursing home, constructed in 2022 and situated in a low-traffic green area, housed 93 residents within its authorized capacity across 62 double-occupancy rooms with en suite bathrooms. It registered risk points only for the absence of dedicated air purifiers, common dining practices, and participation in high-risk group activities, yielding a total structural score of 3, classified as low risk. In contrast, the prison, an older facility located in an urban center, operated at 17 percent over its designated 64-person capacity, accommodating approximately 75 individuals in 38 shared cells. Visible humidity issues, shared bathroom facilities, lack of automated temperature and humidity controls, and security prohibitions against keeping disinfectants inside cells contributed to a high-risk structural score of 13. Surveys assessing resident vulnerability further differentiated the cohorts, gathering data from 25 nursing home residents with an average age of 86 years and 36 incarcerated individuals with an average age of 47 years. The nursing home population demonstrated higher individual medical vulnerability, with every enrolled resident presenting a Charlson Comorbidity Index score of 3 or higher and 80 percent reporting previous bouts of pneumonia. Conversely, incarcerated participants exhibited markedly higher lifestyle-related respiratory exposure scores, characterized by an 81 percent active smoking rate, universal passive smoke exposure, high rates of inhaled substance abuse, and substantial occupational exposures to airborne agents. Lower vaccination coverage among incarcerated individuals—including complete absence of pneumococcal vaccination and high rates of missing influenza shots—contributed to an overall resident risk score of 6.6 for the prison cohort compared to 3.4 for the nursing home group. Discover more Study Biology Find Lung Care respiratory infections Indoor chemical characterization across repeated active sampling campaigns highlighted divergent atmospheric pollutant profiles between the facilities. In preliminary passive screening, investigators identified more than 180 volatile organic compounds across both sites, with 72 shared compounds, 41 unique to the prison, and 45 unique to the nursing home. Chemical air in the nursing home was predominantly characterized by alcohols and terpenoids, consistent with intensive institutional cleaning regimens, whereas the correctional facility exhibited elevated relative abundances of aromatic hydrocarbons, oxygenated compounds, and combustion-related alkanes. Total volatile organic compounds exceeded operational screening thresholds in all 16 sampling rounds in the nursing home and in 71.4 percent of prison rounds. However, benzene and toluene thresholds were breached far more frequently within the prison environment, where benzene exceeded guidelines in 42.8 percent of visits and toluene in 21.4 percent. Because direct carbon dioxide monitoring could not be deployed inside the prison due to institutional security protocols, researchers relied on active measurements of isoprene, an endogenous volatile organic compound continuously released via human exhalation, as a proxy indicator for occupant presence and ventilation adequacy. Using 74 paired measurements from the nursing home, investigators calibrated a linear regression model that accounted for 89 percent of carbon dioxide variance. Across the comparative monitoring period, geometric mean isoprene concentrations reached 52 micrograms per cubic meter in the prison compared to 19 micrograms per cubic meter in the nursing home, reflecting higher occupancy density, constrained ventilation, and consistently higher estimated carbon dioxide accumulations in the correctional facility. Microbiological monitoring across active air collection and template-delimited surface swabbing detected ubiquitous bacterial presence but low overall viral contamination in routine environmental matrices. Total bacterial counts occurred in 96.6 percent of nursing home air collections and in 100 percent of prison air collections, while surface detection frequencies reached 28.7 percent in the nursing home and 52.2 percent in the prison. Opportunistic pathogens such as Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus appeared regularly in air samples from both settings but less frequently on contact surfaces. Across both sites, human adenovirus emerged as the most frequently isolated virus from air and surfaces, followed by sporadic detections of SARS-CoV-2, while influenza and respiratory syncytial viruses were not recovered from air or surface swabs. Overall median microbial risk scores settled at 4.0 in the nursing home and 5.0 in the prison, placing both within low-to-intermediate brackets. Wastewater surveillance tracked pathogen circulation independently of recognized clinical cases, though its capacity to provide an actionable early warning varied across settings. In the nursing home, SARS-CoV-2 was detected in sewage grab samples in late November 2023 at approximately 1,000 genome copies per liter, 63 days prior to the recognition of an institutional COVID-19 outbreak in late January 2024 involving five residents and five staff members. Sewage viral loads escalated sharply during the outbreak, surpassing 100,000 genome copies per liter, before receding to intermittent low-level signals. In the prison, SARS-CoV-2 appeared in sewage as a single sharp peak in December 2023 coincident with a cluster of three confirmed and multiple suspected clinical cases, precluding lead-time evaluation. Human adenovirus circulated continuously in municipal treatment plants and intermittently in facility wastewater, demonstrating persistent community presence without corresponding institutional disease spikes. Synthesizing the four evaluative domains into an unweighted global risk score produced a cumulative rating of 27.6 for the prison, categorized as intermediate risk, compared to 11.7 for the nursing home, classified as low risk. The authors emphasized that the score functions as a comparative and operational screening framework rather than an empirical probability calculation of clinical infection rates. Structural inequalities, air quality constraints, and environmental persistence of viral nucleic acids underlined the multidimensional nature of respiratory risk in institutional settings. The investigators noted that the small sample sizes, limited clinical case counts, and resource-intensive analytical protocols represent key exploratory limitations, indicating that simplified indicator panels like total bacterial counts and screening volatile organic compounds will require broader validation before routine adoption. analysis.time: The study was conducted between November 2023 and February 2025 for the nursing home, and between December 2023 and December 2024 for the prison. The article was published on November 20, 2026 (N1, N46).
analysis.location_and_population: The study took place in an Italian nursing home and a remand prison. The nursing home housed 93 residents, with an average age of 86 years, and the prison accommodated approximately 75 individuals, with an average age of 47 years (N11, N15, N13).
analysis.event: An integrated monitoring system was developed and tested to assess respiratory infection risks in institutional settings, including human adenovirus as one of the viral targets. The system combined structural evaluations, indoor air and surface monitoring, wastewater testing, and clinical tracking (N1, N6).
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study identified operational contrasts between the two facilities, with the nursing home classified as low risk (structural score of 3) and the prison as high risk (structural score of 13). The nursing home population showed higher medical vulnerability, with 80% reporting previous pneumonia, while the prison population had higher lifestyle-related respiratory exposure (N12, N14, N16, N17).
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was a pilot project with limited clinical case counts and resource-intensive protocols. The researchers noted that simplified indicator panels require broader validation before routine adoption (N40).

analysis.brief_en: An integrated monitoring system was developed to assess respiratory infection risks in institutional settings, including nursing homes and prisons. The system combined structural evaluations, indoor air and surface monitoring, wastewater testing, and clinical tracking, as part of the Stell-ARI project by researchers from the University of Pisa and collaborating institutions. The study focused on two Italian facilities: a nursing home with 93 residents, mostly aged 86, and a remand prison housing approximately 75 individuals, mostly aged 47. The nursing home, constructed in 2022 and located in a low-traffic green area, had a low-risk structural score of 3 due to limited risk factors like the absence of dedicated air purifiers. In contrast, the prison, an older facility in an urban center, operated at 17% over capacity and had a high-risk structural score of 13, attributed to factors such as shared bathroom facilities and lack of automated temperature controls. The nursing home population showed higher medical vulnerability, with 80% reporting previous pneumonia, while the prison population had higher lifestyle-related respiratory exposure, including active smoking and substance abuse. The study highlighted the unique challenges of respiratory disease control in closed environments and emphasized the need for further validation of simplified monitoring methods before routine use.
